data.one_liner: Allows Flutter desktop apps to automatically update themselves based on Sparkle and WinSparkle.
data.what_it_does: Provides a plugin for Flutter desktop apps on macOS and Windows to check for updates, set feed URLs, manage update intervals, and install updates using Sparkle and WinSparkle backends.
use_when: You are building a Flutter desktop application for macOS and/or Windows and need auto-update functionality.
You want to use Sparkle or WinSparkle to host and distribute application updates.
avoid_when: You are building for mobile or web platforms where desktop auto-update frameworks like Sparkle do not apply.
You distribute your desktop app exclusively through app stores (like the Mac App Store) that handle updates natively.
strengths: Supports both macOS and Windows via native Sparkle and WinSparkle integrations.
Provides simple command-line tools for generating keys and signing updates.
weaknesses: Requires manual setup of native dependencies like OpenSSL on Windows and specific Info.plist keys on macOS.
data.setup_notes: Requires installing OpenSSL on Windows via Chocolatey, configuring Info.plist keys for macOS, setting up appcast.xml feeds, and handling platform-specific packaging configurations.
